summary: Nokia Corporation filed a Form 6-K reporting the transfer of 687,145 treasury shares without consideration to participants of its equity-based incentive plans, pursuant to a Board resolution announced on 2 October 2025. Following the transfer, Nokia holds 83,304,077 own shares. This is a routine administrative action related to employee incentive compensation, not a special-situation transaction. There are no deal terms, premiums, or strategic implications. The filing is incidental to ordinary share plan administration and does not constitute a capital return or change in control.
